statement: The comparative-efficiency planning surfaces assign the exact Cartesian matrix manifest, digest-resolved root envelope, resource-window join, and separately recomputable capacity and cost effects to C4 before any downstream workload matrix emits evidence.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
This Quest changes planning, specification, and draft Quest contracts only; it must not claim measured capacity, resources, cost, or comparative outcomes.
C4 owns the root matrix evidence envelope and raw-byte digest resolution consumed downstream; C5–C10 may not define parallel evidence roots.
Capacity and cost retain distinct direction conventions, units, source evidence, uncertainty, and eligibility so one invalid effect cannot promote or suppress the other.
